name: Numerically Stable Perspective Transformation
definition: A perspective transformation technique that positions the eye away from the origin to prevent floating-point errors in screen-z values when translating vertices, which otherwise cause ordering inconsistencies during compositing of thousands of closely spaced triangles.
summary: Numerically Stable Perspective Transformation prevents floating-point errors in screen-z values by positioning the eye away from the origin, avoiding ordering inconsistencies during compositing without requiring double-precision arithmetic.
